Using a name, restraint flag or mesh point as a physical-support/grade decision
Dropping unsupported load dependencies or combining selected roots with unrelated cases
Duplicating the existing COM broker or changing frozen getter profiles
Claiming saved-model or installed evidence when the running ETABS instance has no readable file
Guessing helper paths instead of using rg; final text files require LF
